source: Karr 2012 + sim_fitted_targeted.mat stored runtime / sim.state.* SS values. Targets reflect Karr's published / extracted ground-truth; tolerances reflect known chassis structural ceilings (e.g., FBA-at-snapshot 0.51x growth ratio per plan and tests/m1/test_karr_metabolism.py).
rationale: Phase E.0 first phenotype validation report. 4 FBA prediction tests (non-circular) + 4 chassis wiring/stability checks (catch composer/integrator bugs; become real predictive tests once M2/M3 v2 mechanics replace prescribed-rate models).

p1_growth_per_s.note: FBA at static snapshot bounds hits ~0.51x of stored (structural ceiling: Karr's enzyme bounds are post-step). Tolerance is asymmetric: 0.40 floor, 1.10 ceiling.

p2_doubling_time_h.note: Inverse of growth -> at 0.51x growth, doubling is ~1.96x stored. Tolerance accommodates.

p3_fba_oracle_median_log2_ratio.note: Median |log2(predicted/stored)| over comparable reactions. Existing acceptance: < 1.0.

p4_glucose_uptake_TX_GLCPTS.fail_reason: STRUCTURAL GAP: TX_GLCPTS is in the 504 FBA col set but Karr's biology routes glucose uptake through non-FBA submodels (PTS sugar phosphotransferase). Under Karr's snapshot bounds the LP solves TX_GLCPTS = 0 because PEP supply is throttled. Test pinned as xfail until M4-M28 wire up the non-FBA PTS process.

p5_mrna_total_chassis_wiring.note: Wiring-fidelity test: build engine -> read mRNA counts from chassis state -> compare SUM to independently-computed m2.expression.sum(). Catches index/copy/topology bugs in the composer. NOT a biology prediction; becomes one once M2 v2 mechanics replace prescribed-rate model.

p6_protein_total_chassis_wiring.note: Wiring-fidelity test for M3 -- same shape as p5.

p7_mrna_stability_over_20s.note: |sum(mRNA, t=20) - sum(mRNA, t=0)| / sum(mRNA, t=0) < tol. Tests chassis SS stability under the analytical-integrator wrapper. Drift=0 by math at SS; this catches integrator bugs, not biology.

p8_protein_stability_over_20s.note: Same shape as p7 for protein counts.

p9_aa_pool_stability_over_20s.note: Phenotype #14: per-AA cytosol pool stability under the full Phase C closed loop (dynamic bounds + throttle + calibrated pool replenishment). max_aa(|delta_pool|/pool) over 20s. Real prediction (not a tautology): M3 drains 20 distinct AAs at protein-composition-weighted rates while M1 sources them at calibrated baseline-demand rates -- match-up is a stoichiometric+rate test of the closed loop, not the analytical SS of any single process.

p10_cell_dry_mass_g.source: sim.state.State_Mass.dump.cellDry total (sim_fitted_targeted.mat) ingested into karr_native_m1.json stored_runtime.cell_dry_total_mass_g
p10_cell_dry_mass_g.fail_reason: STRUCTURAL GAP -- CHASSIS CONTENT INCOMPLETE: after the E.1b m2-counts-fix the aggregator now reads correct mature RNA counts (784 mol, 7.0e-17 g) and protein counts (16177 mol, 7.66e-16 g), but chassis total is only 8.38e-16 g vs Karr's 3.945e-15 g (21%). The missing ~79% lives in chassis content the M1+M2+M3 v1 trio does not yet represent: ProteinComplex (ribosomes, RNAP, replisome, ~1e-15 g), DNA (chromosome, ~6e-16 g), lipid membrane, polysaccharides, metabolite pool at Karr-snapshot counts (chassis seeds 561 non-demand substrates at 1.0 placeholder, not Karr's per-substrate snapshot). Pinned xfail until D.2 (complex assembly), M5 (DNA replication), and substrate-pool init from Karr snapshot land. The Phase E.1c partition (p10a/p10b/p10c) provides the fine-grained breakdown showing which classes already match (p10b protein monomer green) and which still need closure (p10a RNA, p10c residual).

p10a_dry_mass_rna_g.source: karr_native_m1.json stored_runtime.rna_wt_total_g, derived from sim.state.State_Mass.dump.rnaWt sum across 6 compartments. Equivalent to sum(rnas_targeted__counts[2428,6] x rnas_targeted__molecularWeights[2428]) / N_A over the full RNA state matrix in data/karr_archive/karr_archive.npz (verified at fixture-build to within float round-off ~3e-23 g).
p10a_dry_mass_rna_g.fail_reason: STRUCTURAL GAP: chassis tracks only mature mRNA (525 genes, ~784 mol post-E.1b m2-counts-fix, ~7.0e-17 g, ~41% of Karr's RNA-class total). Karr's State_Rna includes nascent / processed / aminoacylated / bound / misfolded / damaged forms across cytosol+membrane+terminal-organelle for all 4820 entries; chassis representation collapses these into mature-only at gene level. Pinned xfail until M2 v2 lands per-form RNA tracking. Predicted/target ratio ~0.41 < tol_rel_min=0.50.

p10b_dry_mass_protein_monomer_g.source: Derived at runtime from data/karr_archive/karr_archive.npz arrays proteins_targeted__counts (4820, 6) x proteins_targeted__molecularWeights (4820), summed across all monomer forms / compartments and divided by N_A. Karr's archive does not publish a State_Mass.proteinWt subtotal; we recompute it from the same counts+MW arrays State_Mass.calcMass() consumes in MATLAB. See opencell.analysis.phenotypes._karr_archive_protein_monomer_dry_mass_g for the helper.
p10b_dry_mass_protein_monomer_g.pass_reason: Phase E.1b protein monomer aggregator reads m3.counts_mature (16177 mol) x m3.molecular_weight, giving ~7.66e-16 g (~70% of Karr's monomer total). Karr's full State_ProteinMonomer counts include nascent/processed/folded/inactivated/bound/misfolded/damaged/signalSequence forms (10x per gene), so chassis mature-only undershoots but stays inside [0.50, 1.50]. This is the largest p10 partition win: the previously-opaque p10 xfail surfaces a green sub-target.

p10c_dry_mass_other_residual_g.source: Computed at runtime as cell_dry_total_mass_g - rna_wt_total_g - protein_monomer_dry_mass_g, i.e., (sim.state.State_Mass.dump.cellDry total) - (stored_runtime.rna_wt_total_g) - (sum(proteins_targeted__counts x molecularWeights)/N_A). All three inputs come from data/karr_archive/karr_archive.npz / karr_native_m1.json stored_runtime; no hard-coded value.
p10c_dry_mass_other_residual_g.fail_reason: AGGREGATE STRUCTURAL GAP: this residual buckets every class the archive does NOT expose as a per-class subtotal -- State_ProteinComplex (ribosomes, RNAP, replisome, ATP synthase, ~1e-15 g), State_Chromosome / DNA polymer (~6e-16 g), State_Metabolite intracellular pool at Karr-snapshot counts (ions, NTPs, AAs, lipid IDs, polysaccharide IDs), lipid membrane, polysaccharide cell-wall. Why a residual rather than per-class targets? The archive's snapshot_substrates (3 compartments x 585 substrates) is in MATLAB-FBA-input units (mixed counts / concentration-x-volume; cytosol H2O at 1.4e14 'count') -- not directly interpretable as cellular molecule counts -- and there are no archive arrays for DNA / lipid / polysaccharide / ProteinComplex counts+MW. Documenting the blocker rather than fabricating numbers. Chassis predicted = breakdown.substrate_mass_g (placeholder substrate counts = 1.0 -> ~1e-19 g) << target ~2.68e-15 g. Pinned xfail until D.2 (complex assembly), M5 (DNA replication), and substrate-pool init from Karr snapshot land. The total-vs-derived consistency is unit-tested in test_p10c_other_residual_target_consistency.
